source_plan: E:\git冲突问题\rehab image\动作分步骤示范图制作清单_v1.0.md
method: built-in image_gen edits and byte-preserving copies; no API/CLI or programmatic pixel editing
qa_scope: 33 selected frames actually viewed for pose, character/style, normal proportions, contact and sequence; PNG headers, hashes and links checked. Artwork does not establish clinical protocol validity or precise angle measurement.
selection_notes: 052最终为左手：s02复用原图；后腰s03_v2、s04_v2采用左手。右手候选未采用。
054为三个小圈取样姿势；PNG无烧入方向箭头，正反方向与停顿用总览文字表达，排版可另加路线标记。
055的I/Y/T/W是四组独立路线，不能连成一次八步。T/W垫后缘延伸；s05指尖靠近下缘但完整可见。
051与060有少量构图／前臂轮廓生成差异，保留在原记录，不作为精确测角对照。
选用目录使用统一标准文件名，来源可追溯到steps中的具体v2或原图；未采用候选保留。

frames.name: 肩水平内收/水平外展功能筛查
frames.description: 人物站稳，测试上臂在身前抬起至所选舒适高度，肘可自然轻弯。
frames.qa: 右臂身前前举，左臂放松；人像比例及整体画面通过。
frames.prompt: Edit the supplied rehabilitation photograph into a single new pose image, not a collage. Reference images 1–3 lock the exact same East Asian adult woman, face, age, black low ponytail, white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, realistic skin texture, soft studio lighting and the identical pale gray-blue backdrop. Reference image 4 is the pose/camera anchor. This image is 051 E-AXU-015 s01, preparation for shoulder horizontal adduction/abduction: standing comfortably, torso faces straight ahead, LEFT arm relaxed down at the side. Her RIGHT upper arm is lifted straight FORWARD in front of her at comfortable roughly shoulder level, pointing in the same direction her chest faces; right elbow naturally almost straight, palm down, wrist neutral, five relaxed fingers. The right arm must project forward, not sideways across her chest. Camera slightly above and in front, three-quarter view matching reference4 orientation, but wide enough that the entire right arm and hand will also fit in later sideways positions. Single landscape 3:2 clinical studio photo, head to upper thighs, woman centered, ample clear space BOTH sides for a full outstretched arm; maintain natural adult head/body/limb proportions, no stretched forearms or large head. Chest, both shoulders, right shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand all visible. Keep face, clothes, background hue and lighting exact; no text, diagrams, arrows, extra people, exercise equipment, or weights. Only one pose, anatomical plausibility.

frames.prompt: Single new rehabilitation pose photo by editing reference4, not a collage. References1–3 are the exact woman/face/clothes/gray-blue studio style anchors. Reference4 is the actual step01 camera anchor: preserve its landscape 3:2 canvas, framing from head to upper thighs, woman size, face, ponytail, shirt, trousers, chest/head orientation, left hanging arm, lighting and gray-blue backdrop exactly. Change ONLY the RIGHT ARM to the horizontal ADDUCTION endpoint. The woman's chest remains facing the same direction, no torso turn. Her right upper arm is raised at the SAME shoulder-level height and brought across the front of her chest toward her LEFT shoulder/left side. Right elbow softly almost straight, right hand reaches across the body to her LEFT (toward image-right), palm down, wrist straight, all five fingers natural.
